_comment: Windows app -> CachyOS mapping. 'match' is a regex against the Windows uninstall DisplayName. 'paru' installs repo + AUR packages, 'flatpak' installs from Flathub. 'backup' lists Windows config paths the exporter copies into <backup>/apps/<id>/<dest>. 'restore' maps those dests to Linux paths for restore.py. Add your own entries; unmatched installed apps are listed in REPORT.md under 'Unmapped'.

apps.name: 7-Zip
apps.note: Dolphin/Ark handle archives natively too.

apps.name: AMD Software (Adrenalin)
apps.note: GPU drivers are built into the kernel/Mesa. LACT gives overclock/fan/power controls.

apps.name: ASUS Aura / Armoury
apps.note: OpenRGB controls Aura RGB. BIOS updates: use the BIOS EZ Flash, not an app.

apps.name: Battle.net
apps.note: Install Battle.net through Lutris (search 'Battle.net' installer), or add Battle.net-Setup.exe to Steam as a non-Steam game with Proton. WoW, WoW Forever, Overwatch all run well.

apps.name: Brave
apps.note: Turn on Brave Sync and save the sync chain code BEFORE wiping.

apps.name: calibre
apps.note: Library location is stored as a Windows path; re-point it on first launch.

apps.name: Google Chrome
apps.note: Confirm Chrome Sync is on (chrome://settings/syncSetup) before wiping.

apps.name: Claude
apps.note: Install Claude Code natively: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash

apps.name: CurseForge
apps.note: WowUp-CF manages CurseForge WoW addons on Linux. Your addons themselves are backed up with the WoW Interface folder.

apps.name: Discord
apps.note: Vesktop (flatpak) fixes screen-share audio on Wayland.

apps.name: XIVLauncher / FFXIV

backup.src: %PERSONAL%\My Games\FINAL FANTASY XIV - A Realm Reborn

apps.note: XIVLauncher.Core is native. Copy ffxiv-config (keybinds, HUD, char settings) after first launch.

apps.name: GitHub CLI
apps.note: Run gh auth login again.

apps.name: iCloud
apps.note: No Linux client. Use icloud.com, or rclone for iCloud Drive.

apps.name: LM Studio
apps.note: AppImage from lmstudio.ai. Models on a drive you keep can be reused.

apps.name: LockHunter
apps.note: Not needed: use 'lsof <file>' or 'fuser -v <file>'.

apps.name: Microsoft 365
apps.note: Use office.com in the browser, or OnlyOffice for local .docx/.xlsx.

apps.name: OneDrive
apps.note: IMPORTANT if Documents/Desktop/Pictures are redirected into OneDrive: make sure OneDrive says 'up to date' before wiping, then run 'onedrive --sync' on Linux.

apps.name: VS Code
apps.note: Extensions list is exported to vscode-extensions.txt; restore.py reinstalls them. Settings Sync also works.

apps.name: Visual Studio 2022
apps.note: No Linux version. Use JetBrains Rider (rider in AUR) or VS Code + C# Dev Kit.

apps.name: Mullvad Browser
apps.note: No sync. Export bookmarks to HTML before wiping if you need them.

apps.name: Notepad++
apps.note: Unsaved tabs are exported as plain files you can open in any editor. Notepad++ itself runs under Wine; restore.py --npp-wine puts your whole session back into a Wine prefix.

apps.name: OBDwiz / OBDUpdater
apps.note: Windows-only. Try in Wine/Bottles, or keep a small Windows VM for car diagnostics.

apps.name: Obsidian
apps.note: If the vault lives in OneDrive or another synced folder, sync it first, then 'Open folder as vault'. Vault settings live in .obsidian inside the vault, so they come with it.

apps.name: Ollama
apps.note: ROCm build for AMD GPUs (use plain 'ollama' or 'ollama-cuda' otherwise). Models are copied only with -IncludeModels. restore.py prints the move commands for the ollama service.

apps.name: Paint.NET
apps.note: Pinta is the closest match. Krita/GIMP for heavier work.

apps.name: Plaud
apps.note: Use web.plaud.ai.

apps.name: Plex Media Server
apps.note: Stop Plex Media Server before exporting. Follow Plex's 'move server to another OS' guide: copy data to /var/lib/plex/Plex Media Server and convert registry.reg to Preferences.xml, then fix library paths.

apps.name: Proton Mail Bridge
apps.note: Sign in again. Mail clients will need the new bridge password.

apps.name: Rustup
apps.note: Run 'rustup default stable' after install.

apps.name: Qwen
apps.note: Use chat.qwen.ai.

apps.name: qBittorrent
apps.note: All torrents, resume data, categories, RSS and settings are restored with save paths rewritten to Linux mount points.

apps.name: Samsung Magician
apps.note: Use 'sudo smartctl -a /dev/nvme0' for health. Firmware updates need Magician (or Samsung's ISO), so update Samsung SSDs BEFORE wiping.

apps.name: ShareX
apps.note: KDE's Spectacle (preinstalled) covers screenshots + recording. ShareX history/screens are in OneDrive\Documents\ShareX.

apps.name: Signal
apps.note: Desktop history can't be moved. Re-link from your phone (Settings > Linked devices).

apps.name: Steam
apps.note: Enable Proton for all titles in Steam > Settings > Compatibility. proton-cachyos is in the CachyOS repos.

apps.name: Stremio
apps.note: Addons sync with your Stremio account.

apps.name: Synergy
apps.note: Deskflow is the open-source upstream of Synergy and talks to Synergy 3 clients.

apps.name: Tailscale
apps.note: The new install is a new node. Remove the old Windows node in the admin console.

apps.name: Ubisoft Connect
apps.note: Run through Lutris, or launch the Steam copies with Proton (Ubisoft Connect loads automatically).

apps.name: Unity
apps.note: Unity Editor has native Linux builds. Install the same version through Hub.

apps.name: Unsloth
apps.note: pip/uv install unsloth inside a venv. ROCm support varies.

apps.name: Zygor Guides
apps.note: The Zygor client is Windows-only. Run it in WoW's Wine prefix, or update the addon by hand.

apps.name: RuneScape / OSRS
apps.note: Bolt is a native Linux Jagex launcher (RS3, OSRS via RuneLite).

apps.name: Root
apps.note: Check rootapp.com for a Linux build. Otherwise use the web version.

apps.name: Komac
apps.note: winget manifest tool. Not needed on Linux.

always.name: PowerShell profile
always.note: Reference only. Port aliases to ~/.config/fish/config.fish (CachyOS default shell is fish).

always.name: Windows Terminal
always.note: Reference only (colors, profiles). Konsole or Ghostty on Linux.

games._comment: Known Linux status overrides. Everything else gets a ProtonDB link. Anti-cheat status changes, so check areweanticheatyet.com before you wipe.

launchers.Overwatch: Battle.net via Lutris, or the Steam version.
